steps.title: Hosted Services
steps.text: Run Surgewave consumers as background services using IHostedService and BackgroundService. Lesson 13.1 covers the StartAsync, ExecuteAsync, and StopAsync lifecycle.

steps.title: Dependency Injection
steps.text: Register Surgewave clients with the DI container. Use singleton lifetime for long-lived producers and consumers, and scoped lifetime for request-specific message handlers.

steps.title: Health Checks
steps.text: Implement IHealthCheck for broker connectivity, consumer lag monitoring, and producer health. Health states progress from Healthy to Degraded to Unhealthy.

steps.title: Minimal API Endpoints
steps.text: Create Minimal API endpoints for producing messages and add correlation middleware for request tracking across your event-driven system.

steps.title: Architecture Overview
steps.text: See how the HTTP pipeline, background services, DI container, and health checks integrate with the Surgewave broker in a complete ASP.NET Core application.
